problem.title: Level Spreads
problem.statementMarkdown: For each occupied level of the binary tree, return its largest value minus its smallest value. Return levels from root downward. Inputs guarantee these differences fit a signed 32-bit integer.

examples.explanation: The root has spread 0; children span -5 to 4.
An empty tree has no levels.

constraints.text: Each level difference fits a signed 32-bit integer.

attribution: Original Quorem statement and fixture corpus, authored for this project.

implementations.referenceSource: let levelSpreads (root:tree_node option) = let rec loop acc level = match level with [] -> List.rev acc | _ -> let lo=List.fold_left (fun v (n:tree_node) -> min v n.value) max_int level and hi=List.fold_left (fun v (n:tree_node) -> max v n.value) min_int level in let next=List.concat_map (fun (n:tree_node) -> List.filter_map Fun.id [n.left;n.right]) level in loop ((hi-lo)::acc) next in match root with None -> [] | Some n -> loop [] [n]
